newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telerj downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telerj downgraded to hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc and its local associate Banco Patrimonio said they have downgraded Brazilian telecoms firm Telerj to hold from buy following the release of second-quarter results.

-- Patrimonio analysts Ricardo Gurman said Telerj's 46 million-real first half net income, down 36 percent decline year-on-year, was "below our 304 million-real estimate for the entire year and is mainly a result of lower-than-expected revenues."
-- He said he will probably lower his year-end forecasts for Telerj.
-- Gurman cited lower-than-expected network and trafffic growth and the hike in revenues Telerj transfers to long-distance Embratel.
-- "With the estimate reduction, we believe Telerj's multiples will not remain attractive," he said.
-- Telerj common closed Tuesday at 160 reais while its preferred ended at 169.50 reais on the Saop Paulo bourse.
